title: Private tour of Santa Cruz ( the Jewish Quarter) and Cathedral
text: My wife and I visited Seville for part of our honeymoon in February 2018. We had two tour guides during our trip- Danny for the Jewish Quarter and Maria for the Cathedral. Before I get into the meat of the review I should note that while our tour began at 2:00 the cathedral was set to close at 4:00 on this day. We received a call the night prior to the tour confirming that our guide for the day would meet us at the hotel at two.
